messages:
Maya Patel: FYI — starting right-size convo for ACME Payroll private pod. They forecast baseline 200 reqs/s for text-generation (avg 40 tokens), Q4 promo -> 3x peak for ~10 days. Need GPU hours, rack count, network planning. Any quick rules of thumb? :thinking:

Todd Nguyen: For gen workloads we use tokens/sec per GPU. With H100 ~ 6500 tokens/s per GPU at 512 seq for gpt-like 7B; A100 ~ 3200. If avg 40 tokens + 200 req/s -> 200*40=8000 tokens/s baseline. Baseline fits ~2 H100s (8000/6500=1.23) but with batching headroom and redundancy recommend 4 nodes.

Sana Ali: Can you paste expected latency SLO? Also do they need isolation (no multi-tenant)?

Maya Patel: SLO 95% <= 250ms. Yes private-only customer, dedicated pods.

Todd Nguyen: With 250ms SLO we can't over-batch. Assume 1.5x headroom for bursts. Simple calc:
```
# tokens needed at Q4 peak
baseline_tokens = 200 * 40
peak_tokens = baseline_tokens * 3
tokens_per_gpu = 6500  # H100 @ 512
required_gpus = ceil(peak_tokens * 1.5 / tokens_per_gpu)
```
That gives: baseline_tokens=8000, peak=24000, required_gpus≈6 (24000*1.5/6500 ≈5.54) -> round up to 6. Recommend 6x H100.

Rajesh Kumar: If they care about cost we can mix with A100 reserved plus H100 burst nodes. Also consider quantized 4-bit/8-bit kernels — cuts tokens/s by ~1.2-1.5 depending on model but saves memory and allows more concurrency per GPU.

Maya Patel: Network question: single VPC over peering to their DC. We saw issues with UDP MTU and kernel TCP offload earlier. Anything we should flag?

Todd Nguyen: For cross-site peering ensure MTU 9000 end-to-end, enable jumbo frames for RoCE if using RDMA. Also plan for 25-50 Gbps per rack if running 6 H100s (NVLink across GPUs in node reduces cross-node traffic but model parallelism may require 100G). We'd recommend 2x 100GbE uplinks per rack for headroom.

ops-bot: Deployment check: no overlapping CIDRs, peering status=OK, preflight tests pending.

Sana Ali: Also add KV cache prewarm: for cold starts, prefix cache across nodes will cause latency; prewarm top 10k prefixes during rollout. That reduces token compute by ~12% and cuts P99 on cold requests.

Maya Patel: Any thoughts on storage for model artifacts and snapshotting? Backups during canary?

Todd Nguyen: Use local NVMe for model-mmap, replicate to NFS for snapshots. For canary do staged rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic fallback to quantized variant on regressions.

Maya Patel: Nice. Can someone draft a one-pager with recommended config (node type, GPU count, rack, networking, cost delta for reserved vs burst) — need to share with sales by EOD Fri.

Rajesh Kumar: I'll draft numbers. Quick rough costing per month (on-prem equivalent): H100 node ~ $x GPU-hours calc in spreadsheet: https://redwood-internal/sheets/priv-pod-costs (share) :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Todd Nguyen: I'll add the network and canary steps. Also add monitoring SLOs (GPU util, KV hit rate, tail latency) and alert thresholds.

Maya Patel: Thanks team, tagging @InfraOncall for capacity scheduling during Q4 window.

InfraOncall: Acknowledged — will reserve maintenance windows and ensure spare GPUs for hot-swap. Estimating additional 2 cold spare nodes to keep N+2.

Maya Patel: Perfect. We'll sync tomorrow 10am PT in eng-platform. End thread.
